PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS

CS3140 SOLID STATE DRIVES

The CS3140 M.2 NVMe Gen4 x4 Solid State Drive is the ideal solution for PC enthusiasts, gamers, and video rendering professionals to upgrade to the latest in NVMe technology. The NVMe Gen4 x4 interface delivers extreme performance of up to 7,500MB/s seq. read and 6,850MB/s seq. write speeds.

Offered with an optional extruded aluminum heatsink, It is designed to be an extreme high performance SSD to deliver the performance you demand for your laptop or desktop system. Boot up in seconds, enjoy lightning fast application launches, and incredible system performance. The PNY XLR8 CS3140 is highly durable, less likely to fail, and features a 5-year warranty or TBW.*

The PNY XLR8 CS3140 is ... We've taken the world's most advanced NAND flash and refined the CS3140 to achieve a higher threshold for endurance and reliability. PNY's extensive testing and rigorous validation process ensures compatibility across various platforms and multiple operating systems.

The CS3140 M.2 NVMe Gen4 x4 Solid State Drive is designed to be an extreme high performance SSD to deliver the performance you demand for your laptop or desktop system. It is the ideal solution for PC enthusiasts, gamers, and video rendering professionals to upgrade to the latest in NVMe technology. # CS3140 M.2 NVMe 4TB SSD with Heatsink

##### Applications

- NVMe upgrade from a SATA based solid state drive (SSD) or traditional hard drive in an NVMe enabled computer
- Extreme high performance; faster than NVMe Gen3 and SATA based solid state drives
- Integrated extruded aluminum heatsink improves performance during extended intense workloads

##### Features and Benefits

- Sequential Read of up to 7,500 MB/s and Write of up to 6,850 MB/s
- Faster boot up and quicker application launch
- Extreme performance is ideal for demanding applications, high-end games, and intense workloads
- Low power consumption, cool and quiet operation
